about: Shared test cases for the narration reading rules (narration/reading.py spoken()). Each case: a line ({text, reading?, say?}), the readings dictionary it runs with (seed dictionary not included), the text the engine must receive, and the English words left unread. Another engine that claims to follow YES's reading rules runs these cases unchanged.
